intro.label: Config file info
intro.body:
Config can also be changed by manually altering config file.

Config file location:
- [WoT game directory]/mods/configs/DistanceMarker/config.json
intro.note: If you want to generate default config file, delete it and launch a game again.
mod-language.body:
Selects the language of the mod interface.
- Englisch - English interface,
- Deutsch - German interface (default).
visibility-settings.label: Visibility settings
display-mode.body:
Configures when marker should be displayed:
- Always - displays marker always,
- On ALT pressed - when ALT key is being pressed.
marker-target.body:
Configures for which tanks marker should be displayed:
- Ally and enemy - for all tanks,
- Only enemy - only for enemies.
position-settings.label: Position settings (draggable in battle with mouse)
anchor-position.body:
Position at which markers are initially displayed with zero offsets:
- Tank marker - at standard tank marker position,
- Tank center - at tank center position,
- Tank bottom - at tank bottom position.
lock-position-offsets.body: When checked, markers positions offsets can no longer be edited during battle.
Useful if you want to prevent accidental change.
anchor-horizontal-offset.body:
Controls horizontal marker offset relative to anchor position, in pixels.
Positive values moves marker to right side, negative values - to left side.

Hint: Offsets can be visually edited during battle by dragging markers 
with mouse while CTRL key is being held.
Offsets will be saved in configuration on battle finish or manual exit.
anchor-vertical-offset.body:
Controls vertical marker offset relative to anchor position, in pixels.
Positive values moves marker upwards, negative values - downwards.

Hint: Offsets can be visually edited during battle by dragging markers 
with mouse while CTRL key is being held.
Offsets will be saved in configuration on battle finish or manual exit.
visual-settings.label: Visual settings
text-size.body: Base size of text displayed in marker.
text-alpha.body:
Controls transparency of text in markers:
- value 1.0 means full visibility,
- value 0.0 means zero visibility.
draw-text-outline.body: When checked, text is additionally displayed with black outline.
Very useful when text blends with arbitrary shapes (for example: hover icon of vehicle markers).
draw-text-shadow.body: When checked, text is additionally displayed with smooth gradient shadow.
Useful when text blends with background.
draw-distance-unit.body: When checked, distance is additionally displayed with meter unit (like "420 m").
imprecise-display-mode.body:
Select when the "^" symbol is shown instead of the rounded distance:
- Always "^": The symbol is always displayed.
- "^" near view-circle change: Exact numbers are shown in special ranges.
- Always numbers: Distance values are always displayed.
distance-zone-colors.label: Distance zones
near-distance-color.body: Color of the marker text for tanks up to 50 m (proxy spotting area).
text-color.body: Color of the marker text for tanks between 51 and 175 m.
zone3-distance-color.body: Color of the marker text for tanks between 176 and 250 m.
zone4-distance-color.body: Color of the marker text for tanks between 251 and 300 m.
zone5-distance-color.body: Color of the marker text for tanks between 301 and 445 m.
far-distance-color.body: Color of the marker text for tanks further than 445 m (potential detection range).
size-bonus-zone1.body: Additional text size added to the base text size for tanks up to 50 m.
size-bonus-zone2.body: Additional text size added to the base text size for tanks between 51 and 175 m.
size-bonus-zone3.body: Additional text size added to the base text size for tanks between 176 and 250 m.
size-bonus-zone4.body: Additional text size added to the base text size for tanks between 251 and 300 m.
size-bonus-zone5.body: Additional text size added to the base text size for tanks between 301 and 445 m.
size-bonus-zone6.body: Additional text size summand for tanks further than 445 m.
